criteria.title: Target vehicle-computer identity
criteria.passCondition: Hardware model, CPU architecture, RAM, storage, OS image, kernel/runtime and display class are recorded in the physical evidence package with only privacy-bounded hardware-instance identity.

criteria.title: Software and dependency identity
criteria.passCondition: Git commit, product version, package lock digest, SBOM and build provenance resolve to the tested installation and are bound to retained evidence digests.

criteria.title: Firmware, configuration and calibration identity
criteria.passCondition: Signed firmware manifest/revision, configuration revision and sensor calibration revision are recorded and compatible with the tested software build.

criteria.title: Power-cycle and boot-to-ready
criteria.passCondition: Cold/warm power cycles complete without unsafe state and target-hardware boot-to-usable-driver-surface measurements are recorded with an approved project-specific threshold.

criteria.title: HMI performance under representative load
criteria.passCondition: Target display records frame-time/jank under map, surround and warning load, and demonstrates deterministic fallback after renderer loss.

criteria.title: Long-duration resource soak and field diagnostics
criteria.passCondition: Target hardware completes an approved multi-hour soak with bounded RSS/heap, event-loop, uptime, memory and thermal evidence, plus a fresh privacy-bounded field-diagnostics capture with explicit instrumentation coverage.

criteria.title: Fault injection and degraded modes
criteria.passCondition: Applicable HIL scenarios exercise sensor loss/staleness, reconnect, provider loss, storage/evidence degradation, renderer loss, restart, update and power-fault behavior while preserving truthful degraded states and warning-only authority.

criteria.title: Update rollback and recovery
criteria.passCondition: Signed update rejection, incompatible release rejection, failed-install recovery, power interruption and rollback are exercised against the selected physical target release chain with retained evidence bindings.

criteria.title: Controlled closed-track execution
criteria.passCondition: Separately approved scenarios are executed only in a controlled facility within approved bounds, with frozen software/configuration/calibration identity, synchronized evidence, operator and independent observer records, and no public-road exposure.

criteria.title: Independent acceptance review
criteria.passCondition: Independent functional-safety/SOTIF, cybersecurity, vehicle-computer/harness, driver-HMI/human-factors and evidence-integrity reviewers complete the submitted evidence review for the defined controlled-track scope; public-road and homologation approval remain separate decisions.
